description: The binding-K enumerator ranks carrier candidates by Frobenius residual. Read off its own recorded output, that criterion has three independent fatal defects: its rank-1 pick is an intra-nucleon self-crossing that binds nothing, its rank-1/rank-2 ordering is a 2-ULP float64 tie-break between two candidates that block symmetry makes exactly equal, and the two genuine interface generators are exactly degenerate. Extending the word-length bound cannot help. Nothing was re-run.

generator_classification.rule: sigma_i is inter-component iff 3 | i, for offsets [0,3,6]

assertions.name: the '..._extended' field is 2/3 INTRA-nucleon despite its name
assertions.detail: 8 of 12 signed entries are intra-nucleon; only sigma_3 (interface 1|2) and sigma_6 (interface 2|3) join different nucleons

assertions.name: DEFECT 1 -- the residual's rank-1 pick is a SELF-CROSSING, both nuclei
assertions.detail: rank-1 is [-8,-8] = sigma_8^-2 for both 3H and 3He; sigma_8 joins strands 8,9, both inside nucleon 3, so the carrier has zero inter-component crossings and countChannel = 0 -- it binds nothing (Lean selfCrossing_countChannel_eq_zero)

assertions.name: rank-2 is also a self-crossing
assertions.detail: rank-2 is [-5,-5] = sigma_5^-2, inside nucleon 2; the first genuine interface candidate appears only at rank 3

assertions.name: DEFECT 2 -- the rank-1/rank-2 gap is 2 ULP, i.e. float64 rounding
assertions.detail: gaps measure 2.0 and 2.0 ULP; sigma_5 and sigma_8 are the SAME generator of two different nucleon blocks, so block symmetry makes the true residuals EQUAL -- the rank-1 slot is decided by rounding, not by mathematics

assertions.name: DEFECT 3 -- the two genuine interfaces are EXACTLY degenerate
assertions.detail: [-3,-3] and [-6,-6] record the identical residual to every digit in both nuclei, so the criterion cannot distinguish the 1|2 interface from the 2|3 one; it is not selecting, it is tying

assertions.name: the corpus's recorded carrier [3,3] is the MIN-LENGTH pick, not the residual winner
assertions.detail: min_length list heads with [3,3] for all three atoms; the residual-ranked head is [-8, -8]. My earlier claim that 'the principle is not minimality' is right about the code's sort key and wrong about what produced the corpus's carrier

assertions.name: the minimal-set search is 99.8% redundant at L <= 8
assertions.detail: 87,380 words collapse to 145 elements because sigma_3 and sigma_6 commute; the enumerator re-evaluates the same group element hundreds of times

assertions.name: and the minimal-set answer is ANALYTIC -- no search needed at any L
assertions.detail: Brunnian needs lk(1,2) = lk(2,3) = lk(1,3) = 0; those are a/2, b/2 and 0, so a = b = 0, the TRIVIAL carrier, at every length. lk(1,3) = 0 is FORCED: sigma_3 transposes positions 3,4 and sigma_6 transposes 6,7, so a block-1 strand and a block-3 strand never meet. The Borromean needs all three pairs linked, so it is unreachable in this layout

assertions.name: THE FIX -- the enumerator searched 2 of 27 inter-nucleon generators
assertions.detail: a_(t,s) = (sigma_{t-1}...sigma_{s+1}) sigma_s (sigma_{s+1}^-1...sigma_{t-1}^-1), with a_(s+1,s) = sigma_s, so the adjacent generators are a PROPER SUBSET of the bands; the enumerator restricted to sigma_3 and sigma_6, i.e. 2 of the 27 band generators joining different nucleons

assertions.name: and NONE of the 9 bands reaching the 1|3 pair was searched
assertions.detail: the 1|3 bands are [(1, 7), (1, 8), (1, 9), (2, 7), (2, 8), (2, 9), (3, 7), (3, 8), (3, 9)]; every one has |t - s| >= 4, so none is an adjacent transposition and none was in the search set. That is exactly the pair a Brunnian carrier needs, and it is why the Borromean was unreachable -- the generator set, not the layout

assertions.name: RETRACTED -- band generators WERE already in the corpus when I claimed they were not
assertions.detail: I asserted 'no band or Birman-Ko-Lee generator in content/, computations/, docs/'. FALSE at the very commit my checkout sat on (ed4ffbe424): computations/deltalambda/ carried them in >= 6 files, brunnian_route_feasibility_probe.py naming a_{7,3} explicitly. My PATTERN matched them; I piped through `head -10` and content/.../.lake/packages/ sorts first, so six vendored blobs ate the budget and I read the truncation as empty. `head` on a corpus grep is a CORRECTNESS hazard; exclude .lake/ and drop the cap

assertions.name: RETRACTED -- the band route is ~4400x LARGER, not cheaper
assertions.detail: a Brunnian carrier needs n+ = n- >= 1 on each of 3 pairs, so >= 6 band letters; structured that is 382,637,520 candidates against 87,380. I asserted 'cheaper' without computing it. The band set is still the only one that can REACH a Brunnian carrier -- it is necessary, not cheap

assertions.name: BUT the binding cannot see WHICH band -- the space collapses
assertions.detail: countChannel depends only on n+ + n- (Lean countChannel_depends_only_on_total), and SelfMutualPartition makes binding a sum over inter-component crossings, so all 9 bands of a nucleon-pair are binding-equivalent. The binding-relevant space is the triple (m1,m2,m3): 20 triples at c <= 12, against 382,637,520 band words -- a collapse of 19,131,876x

assertions.name: and that SUBSUMES defect 3 rather than sitting beside it
assertions.detail: the residual is being asked to make a distinction the binding does not use; the exact 1|2 vs 2|3 tie is the two-generator shadow of the same fact. So no repair of the ARITHMETIC (mpf instead of float64) can make a trace criterion select among binding-equivalent carriers

assertions.name: extending L_K_max is FUTILE without repairing the criterion
assertions.detail: a longer search re-ranks by a comparator that prefers non-carriers (defect 1), breaks ties in rounding error (defect 2) and is degenerate on the interfaces (defect 3); more candidates do not fix a broken comparator

scope: (b) on the enumerator's selection criterion AS IMPLEMENTED, with the invariants named: the block arithmetic of constituent_offsets (defects 1 and 3) and float64 ULP spacing (defect 2). (a) on the IDEA of residual-based selection, which is untested -- no repaired criterion has been run, and nothing here says one would fail.
caveats: This audits RECORDED output and re-runs nothing. If the witness is regenerated with a different generator set or in exact arithmetic, every number here changes and the audit must be re-done rather than quoted.

The float64 values are read as float64 ON PURPOSE -- they are the subject. The ULP arithmetic is about the recorded data, not a computation of the framework's own quantities. They are SERIALIZED AS repr() STRINGS, which round-trip losslessly, so the witness carries no raw float64 and the ULP ratio is stored as an exact Fraction -- the audited values survive intact without tripping the raw-float64 ratchet.

Defect 3 is a symmetry, not a bug: the 1|2 and 2|3 interfaces ARE equivalent under the construction, so any criterion built from the trace alone will tie them. Breaking that tie needs information the trace does not carry, which is a design question rather than a fix.

The corpus's canonical A=3 carrier (Borromean L6a4) is not reachable from the MINIMAL set at all: sigma_3 and sigma_6 are distant hence commute, so that subgroup is free abelian and Brunnian forces the trivial carrier. The recorded run used the EXTENDED set, where Brunnian carriers do exist.

the_fix_band_generators.verdict: the obstruction is the GENERATOR SET, not the strand layout: adjacent transpositions are a proper subset of the bands, and the subset excludes every generator that links nucleons 1 and 3

cost_RETRACTED.claim: the band route is cheaper than the length-extension
cost_RETRACTED.note: asserted without computing. The band set remains the only one that can REACH a Brunnian carrier, so it is necessary, not cheap

binding_equivalence_collapse.reason: countChannel depends only on n+ + n-, so all 9 bands of a nucleon-pair are binding-equivalent
binding_equivalence_collapse.consequence: the carrier is underdetermined BY THE BINDING ITSELF; a trace criterion is asked to make a distinction the binding does not use, which subsumes defect 3 and is not repairable by switching float64 to mpf

the_fix_band_generators.corpus_status: absent from content/, computations/ and docs/; present in 4 library documents, so a citation rather than a derivation

minimal_set_collapse.reason: sigma_3 and sigma_6 are distant (|3-6| >= 2) hence commute; <sigma_3, sigma_6> is free abelian of rank 2
minimal_set_collapse.verdict: the minimal-set search is unnecessary at any L: Brunnian forces the trivial carrier, and lk(1,3) = 0 is forced by reachability (blocks 1 and 3 never cross), so the Borromean is unreachable in this layout
